statements.statement: The member presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The member has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The member has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms are intermittent and need to be correlated with potential arrhythmic events
CPT code 93247 (long-term continuous ECG monitoring) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained or submitted prior to the service date
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to evaluate for underlying rhythm disturbances
